question: how k and the noise share move with min_cluster_size, and how much each clustering agrees with the shipped label map

matrix.what: the build's own clustering matrix z = (e - mean)/max(std, 1e-6) over the 32-d critic embeddings, restricted to the field rows
matrix.missing: the rendered inventory points, whose embeddings exist only inside a build (rendered audio through the critic) and are in no asset

density.definition: anchored: a dense region holding both documented renders and unlabelled field audio, so the field audio inherits a candidate identity. unknown: dense, real, and nothing documented in it — a candidate new syllable. noise: in no dense region at all.

definitions.noiseShare: share of the clustered rows HDBSCAN put in no dense region
definitions.ariAssigned: adjusted Rand against the shipped label clustering over the non-noise rows only — agreement about the points this clustering placed
definitions.ariAll: adjusted Rand over every clustered row with noise as one label of its own — agreement about the corpus, which a partition refusing most of it does not have
definitions.notMeasured: neither figure is accuracy: the label partition is bookkeeping over the type inventory and has no claim to be correct. The curve identifies no best min_cluster_size; it makes the trade-off visible
